title: Distill to Detect: Exposing Stealth Biases in LLMs through Cartridge Distillation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the bias preference rate using targeted preference questions and the bias leakage rate via unrelated introspective questions, followed by using automated auditing agents (Petri and AuditBench Investigator) to detect the covertly injected preference for owls after applying Distill to Detect (D2D) cartridge distillation.

Measuring the bias preference rate and bias leakage rate through a set of targeted and unrelated questions, and employing automated behavioral auditing agents to detect an injected covert advertisement preference for Fanta after amplifying the signal via Distill to Detect (D2D).
